name: lecturedesk
description: Your local lecture library, recording and learning workspace
author: LectureDesk

scripts.dist:mac: npm run resources && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run resources && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run resources && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run resources && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.pack: npm run resources && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
